overview: Kerala Financial Corporation (KFC) MSME Loans is a state-level financial assistance program providing various loan schemes to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) in Kerala. The corporation offers term loans, working capital loans, and specialized schemes for startups, agro-based MSMEs, government contractors, tourism, infrastructure, and traditional fishermen. KFC aims to boost industrial growth in Kerala by strengthening the MSME sector through financial support up to Rs.50 crore with moratorium periods up to 3 years and repayment periods up to 10 years.
objectives: Boost industrial growth in the state by strengthening the MSME industrial sector
Provide financial assistance to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises in manufacturing and service sector
Support startups in all stages of their growth from proof of concept to scaling up
Assist agro-based MSMEs in agriculture sector
Provide loans to government contractors and MSMEs for executing work orders
Finance tourism sector and infrastructure development projects
Support traditional fishermen to procure mechanized deep sea fishing vessels
Offer working capital assistance to MSMEs at competitive rates
eligibility: Eligibility varies by scheme but generally requires MSME-Udyam Registration, GST registration (exempt for turnover up to Rs.40 lakh manufacturing/Rs.20 lakh service), audited financial statements, work order in hand, satisfactory CIBIL score (minimum 650 for some schemes), promoter age limits (up to 50 years general, up to 55 years for SC/ST/women/NRK), and no permanent employment of promoters. Specific schemes have additional criteria like minimum credit rating of 40%, promoter contribution of 10%, and project viability requirements.
benefits: Loans up to Rs.50 crore, guarantees up to Rs.50 crore, fast track processing, longest moratorium period up to 3 years, longest repayment period up to 10 years, transparent procedures with no hidden charges, in-principal clearance within 7 days, interest rates starting at 9% pa, interest subvention under certain schemes (e.g., 3% state govt + 2% KFC for CMEDP and KAMS), online registration through www.kfc.org, and access to additional services like solvency certificates, consultancy, and insurance products.
financial_support: KFC provides loans up to Rs.50 crore and guarantees up to Rs.50 crore. Interest rates start at 9% pa with specific subventions: CMEDP offers 5% interest (3% govt subvention + 2% KFC rebate), KAMS offers 6% net effective interest after subvention, Startup Kerala offers 5.60-7.60% pa, and Traditional Fisherman scheme offers 5% net effective interest. Moratorium periods range from 6 months to 3 years, repayment periods from 1 year to 10 years. Processing fees are 0.5% plus GST, upfront fees 0.1% plus GST. Financial assistance can be term loan, working capital loan, or combination based on enterprise needs.
application_process: 1. Online enquiry submission through www.kfc.org 2. Document submission 3. Branch verification 4. Training 5. Sanction & Disbursement
